args: 0_just in time for mother's day comes a thrill-free, home-invasion thriller about a mom (gabrielle union) who'll stop at nothing to keep four bad guys from killing her two kids.
7_here's hoping there's an action thriller in the pipeline that makes better use of union's talents.
9_by not making a whole movie worthy of what union is throwing down, it features a breakout wrapped up in a break-in.
11_yes, there's no higher purpose behind the movie, just an ambition to make you enjoy being uneasy.
11_still, in its very limited way, "breaking in" could be called some kind of a good movie.
14_a paint-by-the-numbers plot still leads to an entertaining picture in "breaking in."

15_in the end, the only real suspense comes from seeing whether the film can stretch its wafer-thin premise and paucity of ideas out to a full 90 minutes - and at 88 minutes with credits, even there it comes up short.
1_james mcteigue has a fleet, efficient visual style that keeps the suspense set pieces percolating.
